result.title: Context as a Resource
result.summary: Managing concurrent tasks across separate agent sessions quickly exhausts human attention, motivating always-on personal agents behind a single continuous interface. Yet when every context shares identical frozen backbone weights, funneling interleaved dialogues and external events into one linear session induces cross-topic constraint bleed and head-of-line stalling. Conversely, router-ticket hierarchies incur lossy prose handoffs, heavy routing overhead, and blind merges - collapsing true-conflict repository merges to a 33.3% three-run mean despite high isolated branch passes. Rather than scheduling anthropomorphic roles, we introduce ClonAct, a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks directly through a pluggable single-pass non-generative Context MMU, in-place Context Cells, a footprint-aware Synaptic Bus with an isolated trial merge gate, and a wave-flushed Shared Trunk. Across three programmatic multi-stream benchmarks and three model families, our portable trial merge gate lifts true-conflict merges to 63.3%, while ClonAct's routerless virtualization attains this ceiling with 45.9% fewer prompt tokens and prevents compact-model router collapse. Under continuous surge streams, ClonAct matches top completion (95.0%) with the lowest median wait and zero timed-out status checks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ClonAct：面向多会话常驻个人智能体的无路由上下文虚拟化架构，用 Context MMU、Context Cell、带隔离试验合并门的 Synaptic Bus 与波刷新共享主干来管理多个上下文，并在多流基准上评估合并正确率与等待成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「上下文作为资源」的显式隔离与试验式合并门，可能启发 LVR 中多个推理状态的隔离、合并与冲突验证，以及视觉证据筛选后的状态整合问题，但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，需核查其合并判据是否可移植。
